summary: A person laid off without warning feels stunned and later distrusts the employer.
realLife: An example in a workforce article shows a worker stunned at a conference-room meeting and later distrustful after learning a poor review had been used to justify the layoff. Remaining staff watch how coworkers were treated and rumors spread when communication is poor.
sources: Workforce magazine, A humane approach to layoffs: https://workforce.com/news/a-humane-approach-to-layoffs
inGame: Job-ended event raises or lowers the person's trust through traits and the tie to the employer; coworker reactions follow through ties.

turns.summary: The worker accepts the news calmly and thanks the manager for the notice.
turns.writesBack: The mood stays level, and the tie to the employer stays civil.

turns.summary: The worker is angry and says so in front of others.
turns.writesBack: The tie to the boss turns cold, and coworkers take sides.

turns.summary: The worker was ready to go and feels freed by the layoff.
pulledBy: a person unhappy at the job
turns.writesBack: The mood lifts, the search starts soon, and trust in the employer is little changed.
